title_en: Technology and Engineering (3/20): The Clean Room at a Chip Factory
note_en: 只要…就… (zhǐyào… jiù…) means "as long as… then…": one small condition is enough to trigger the result. 只要晶圆表面有一个很小的瑕疵，整片芯片就可能报废 "Even one tiny flaw on a wafer's surface can mean the whole wafer has to be scrapped." Note that 就 sits after the subject of the second clause (整片芯片就…), while English puts "then" at the front, if it uses it at all.
